# Pascal and Delphi reference records

The 118 cases in `cases.json` come from the pinned TypeScript/WASM implementation
at revision `6aa358ccbae30fbf27318f79ee183212f726f9ba`. The generator evaluates
literal sources and simple fixture helpers from the reference Pascal tests, then
runs the real extractor and preprocessor. Supplemental cases cover DFM/FMX form
components and events, multiline properties, Unicode attributes, and CRLF input.
Expected data is never generated by the Rust implementation.

Each case retains its original source, prepared source, complete canonical
extraction, and the reference's classification when presented as `sample.inc`.
Only timestamps and durations are excluded. The grammar's complete node-kind and
field-name tables are captured from WASM and compared with the native parser.
Separate persistence tests check projected UTF-8 source slices and metadata.

Run `node tests/fixtures/upstream/pascal/regenerate.mjs /path/to/prepared/upstream`
to recapture the pinned reference. The checkout must have its TypeScript output
compiled and reference grammars available. Node is used only to regenerate these
development fixtures; Rust tests consume the committed JSON offline.
